name: GHOULBOX
intro: Dungeon-synth firmware built on Felucca: four tracks, hurdy-gurdy, choirs, hall reverb. Press PLAY first: a D-minor scene is ready.

rows.what: Pick the track (T1-T4) the keys and pages work on.
Back to HOME; on HOME again: MIXER, CLOCK, KEYS, DREAM.
Open the menu: ALGORITHM picks the tab, PRESETS the row.
In dialogs and action pages: yes / do it.
In dialogs and action pages: no / back.
Double-tap a layer button: its key map stays open hands-free.
Start / stop the four tracks.
Tempo.
Change the selected track's sound; its notes stay.
Keyboard an octave down (OCT+ up).
Mute / unmute tracks 1-4.
Solo tracks 1-4 while held; white key 5 unmutes all.
KNOB 1-4 set the levels of tracks 1-4.
Latch a drone on track 1-4: your chord keeps sounding.
Make that note the track's key (ROOT).
On HOME: DREAM page; a key composes a slow piece in it.
On HOME, KNOB 1-4 are the engine's four main controls.
All eight engine controls; more taps: VOICE pages (mono, glide).
Switch the track to another engine (white key 14: INIT).
Envelope: attack, decay, sustain, release.
LFO; more taps: LFO 2, LFO DEST, MOD matrix.
Scale: ROOT, SCL, QNT (WHITE = white keys stay in scale).
Arpeggiator: MODE, RATE, OCT, GATE; tap again for HOLD.
Temporary tweak: snaps back when LFO is let go (OCT+ keeps).
Track's sends, KNOB 1-4: distortion, chorus, delay, reverb.
Next pages: SLICER, DLY, REVERB, CHORUS, TAPE.
REVERB page: TYPE (ROOM, SPRING, HALL), SIZE, DAMP.
TAPE page: tape wobble, CRSH, AMB cave wind, CRKL torch crackle.
Performance effect while held; the map is on screen.
Arm the track and record live (starts play); again to stop.
Clear the track's steps at once (hold SAVE undoes).
PHRASES: pick a pattern with KNOB 1, OCT+ loads it.
KNOB 1-4: length, step division, swing, gate.
Tools: clear, reverse, shift left/right, random, cook.
STEP page: write the key into the cursor step.
On STEP: empty the step (a rest) and move on.
SONG page: chain projects 1-4 (A-D) into a song.
Undo the last sound load, pattern load or clear.
Save the sound to a user slot; name it, OCT+ again.
PROJECT: save everything to the slot on KNOB 1.
PROJECT: load the project in the slot on KNOB 1.
USB rescue (no sound): the web installer can reinstall.
Held 5 s: update mode for the installer; let go cancels.
SYSTEM > RESTORE LAST OFF: power on to the chosen SCENE.

tips: Saving only works while stopped (STOP TO SAVE).
The FM-1 wakes up with your last session: stop for about 10 seconds before switching off.
Hold SAVE is your friend: it undoes a sound or pattern load, a clear or a SEQ tool.
Other power-on scenes (CRYPT, TAVERN, CHAPEL, BLANK): hold HOME, SYSTEM > SCENE.
Hurdy-gurdy crank: on a GURDY sound set COUP to CRANK, then turn SELECT to bow; tempo is then hold GLO + turn SELECT.
Try it in the browser first: ghoulbox.messy.quest.
checked: Button labels: firmware/src/panel.c B_NAME order FX SCL ENV ... = printed FX SEL ENV ...; firmware calls SEL 'SCL'.
Encoders: ui_input.c ui_input(): ALGORITHM = track_select on every page, PRESETS = presets_turn (preset_step on HOME), SELECT = tempo unless BPM LOCK / crank.
HOME tap/hold: ui_input.c btn_hold (0.7 s) -> menu; ui.c home_tap cycles FAM_TRK pages; params.c PAGES: MIXER, CLOCK, KEYS, DREAM.
Page families and order: params.c PAGES; ui.c open_family (SAVE enters USER first, ui.act = 4 so OCT+ saves).

Layers: ui_layer.c LAYERS table + layer_key/layer_knob: GLO black places 0-3 mute, white 0-3 solo, white 4 unmute all, white 7 tap tempo, black 5-8 latch (GLO_LT 5); KNOB 1-4 levels. SCL any key = ROOT. EDIT white keys = engines (NENG_SHOWN 13), next = INIT. SEQ white keys = ui_tools.c TL_CLEAR..TL_COOK. REC white 0 = rec_clear.
Double-tap lock: ui_layer.c header comment and layer_lock (#83).
Hold LFO momentary tweaks: ui_input.c mom_down/mom_turn, OCT+ keeps.
REC tap: ui_input.c rec_tap (stopped -> transport starts, except on STEP where it arms step entry; seq_entry).
EDIT on STEP clears step: ui_input.c page button handler (GR_ROLL).
PROJECT page: params.c {G_SLOT, -, G_LOAD, G_SAVE}; act_do / act_name; STOP TO SAVE in project.c and ui_name.c.
OCT- alone at power-on = rescue: rescue.c rescue_key + bootguard.h bootguard_manual; OCT-+OCT+ held 5 s = UBOOT countdown in main.c; both tapped together resets octave (ui_input.c).
Scenes and defaults: engines.c GB_SCENES (DUNGEON 72 BPM), params.c G_RTYPE default HALL, N_QUANT includes WHITE, FX TAPE page G_TAPE G_CRSH G_AMB G_CRKL.
DREAM: dream.c dream_keys (key composes, confirm if steps exist), ui_input.c song.grid == 4.
Manual URL: GitHub release ghoulbox-v2.3.1 asset GHOULBOX-User-Guide-2.3.pdf (also docs/guide in the tree); catalogue site redirects to ghoulbox.messy.quest web emulator.
unsure: FX layer default key-to-effect map (perform.c) and whether black keys mute tracks there: not traced, so only 'performance effect while held' is shown.
HOME KNOB 1-4 names differ per engine (ANALOG: CUT RES ATK REL per guide); not listed per engine.
panel.c comment says hold OCT- and OCT+ while powering on opens HARDWARE CALIBRATION; not traced in the boot path, left out (also in MENU > SYSTEM).
Crank tip (COUP CRANK, SELECT as crank) taken from README/guide; only crank_select() gating SELECT was seen in ui_input.c.
RESTORE LAST ~10 s autosave delay taken from the guide, not timed in project.c.
